text: I played Hangin’ on a String at my wedding in 1986. Hearing you tell where it came from made me cry in the kitchen.
name: Maureen
reply:
Maureen, thank you. That record was written for a dance floor, and it found its way into a kitchen forty years later. That is exactly where it belongs.

I played it again after reading your note.

text: Never knew Delegation were from Birmingham. Thirty years of dancing to them and I never knew.
name: Tunde
